categories.main_business_segments: China Silver Group Limited operates primarily in two continuing business segments: Manufacturing segment, which involves manufacturing, sales, and trading of silver ingots, palladium, and other non-ferrous metals in the PRC; and New Jewellery Retail segment, operated under CSMall Group, focusing on designing and sales of gold, silver, colored gemstones, gem-set and other jewellery products in the PRC. The Group also had a Fresh Food Retail segment under CSMall Group, which was disposed of in January 2025 and classified as discontinued operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group applies a proprietary production model for manufacturing high-grade silver ingots, palladium, and metal by-products. The manufacturing process involves raw material consumption, purchase of silver, direct labor, and manufacturing overhead. In jewellery retail, product design, research and development, and production are emphasized, with a focus on high-margin silver jewellery products. The Group also leverages online sales channels and digital marketing technologies such as short video marketing and live streaming for sales promotion.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include industrial and trading entities purchasing silver ingots in the PRC, as well as end consumers purchasing jewellery products, particularly silver and gold jewellery, through online and offline retail channels. Major customers contributing over 10% of total revenue are industrial buyers of silver ingots. The Group’s jewellery products target the PRC consumer market, leveraging third-party e-commerce platforms and online marketing to reach a broad customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group’s operations and revenue are predominantly located in the mainland of the People's Republic of China (PRC), with some corporate and investment holding entities based in Hong Kong and the Cayman Islands. Offline retail stores are located in several provinces and municipalities within the PRC, including Beijing, Heilongjiang, Henan, Tibet, and Xinjiang. The Group’s upstream mining exploration activities are focused in Tibet Autonomous Region, PRC.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Silver Group Limited operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the precious metals supply chain. The Manufacturing segment produces silver ingots and related metals, positioning the Group upstream in metal production. The New Jewellery Retail segment operates downstream, focusing on designing and selling finished jewellery products. The Group is expanding upstream through mineral resource exploration and mining activities, aiming to enhance control over raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on consolidating its leading position in precious metals manufacturing and expanding upstream into mineral resource exploration and mining, particularly gold mining in Tibet. It emphasizes cost control, operational efficiency, and shifting jewellery retail towards higher-margin silver products and online sales channels. The Group is also exploring technology-driven marketing methods such as short video and live streaming. R&D efforts include product design and development in jewellery and exploration of semiconductor-related materials like antimony as by-products in mining.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales: manufacturing and selling silver ingots and other metals in the Manufacturing segment, and designing and retailing jewellery products in the New Jewellery Retail segment. The Group also had revenue from SaaS and branding services in the Fresh Food Retail segment before its disposal. Sales channels include direct sales to industrial customers, offline franchised stores, and online platforms such as JD.com, Tmall, and TikTok. The Group also earns income from government grants, scrap material sales, and bank interest.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is positioned as one of the leading silver producers in the PRC and a fully integrated precious metals enterprise. It competes in the upstream precious metals manufacturing market and downstream jewellery retail market. The Group’s strategic shift towards higher-margin silver jewellery and online sales aims to strengthen its competitive position. It faces competition from other precious metals manufacturers and jewellery retailers in China, as well as challenges from fluctuating commodity prices and market demand.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB4.31 billion, a decrease of 20.9% from RMB5.46 billion in 2023, primarily due to lower sales in both manufacturing and jewellery retail segments. Net profit attributable to owners was approximately RMB10 million, down from RMB14.5 million in 2023. The Group maintains a net cash position with a net gearing ratio of -10.3%. Total assets were approximately RMB1.98 billion with equity attributable to owners of RMB461 million. The Group has undergone business restructuring, including disposal of non-core segments, to focus on core precious metals businesses and upstream expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality manufacturing of silver ingots using proprietary production methods, positioning itself as a leading silver producer in China. In jewellery retail, it differentiates by focusing on high-margin silver products with lower customer unit prices, leveraging online sales and innovative digital marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness and sales efficiency. The upstream expansion into gold mining and exploration of semiconductor-related materials like antimony aims to create long-term value and diversify revenue streams. The Group’s integrated supply chain and strategic focus on cost control and profitability underpin its competitive advantage.
